newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt slashes immigration intake.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt slashes immigration intake.

text.p: Australia on Wednesday heavily cut its annual immigration intake for the second consecutive year, citing concerns over stubbornly high unemployment.

Immigration Minister Philip Ruddock said 68,000 migrants would be allowed into the country in the year from July, a more than eight percent cut to the 1996/97 intake of 74,000 -- itself an almost 11 percent cut on the previous year.
The proportion of places for migrants with in-demand work skills was increased 26 percent to 35,260 from 27,650.
